隐秘角落的训诫之力悄然涌动。
知晓所有的不甘与梦想，
能将卑微过往化作荣耀序章
不再于黑暗中徘徊，
它会引领你踏破枷锁，
开启独属于你的传奇。
此刻，抉择就在你手中。
彼之良·卡利亚【训诫之吏/全新材质仿生2.2CF系列/157cm】

The power of discipline surges from hidden corners.
Knowing all discontent and dreams,
it transforms humble past into glorious prelude.
No longer wandering in darkness,
it shall guide you to shatter shackles,
to unveil your unique legend.
Now, the choice rests in your hands.
Bezlya Calla DisciplinaryDominion, Bionic 2.2CF series 157cm
